newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P raises GECC Hong Kong unit's ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P raises GECC Hong Kong unit's ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Wednesday it had raised the long-term ratings of General Electric Capital Corp's (GECC) Hong Kong unit General Electric Capital Finance (GECF).
S&P raised the long-term foreign currency counterparty credit rating and certificate of deposit ratings of GECF to A-plus from single-A.
The foreign currency outlook is now stable.
The move follows S&P's upgrade of Hong Kong's foreign currency rating to A-plus from single-A and the territory's local currency rating to AA-minus from A-plus.
S&P also affirmed GECF's long-term local currency counterparty and certificates of deposit (CD) rating of A-plus and short-term local and foreign currency counterparty and CD ratings of A-1.
The long-term local currency ratings outlook remains stable.
The rating on GECF reflects the ongoing strong support from GECF's U.S.-based parent General Electric Capital Corp, which is rated AAA by S&P.
